name: codex-atlas
description: Repository graph workspace, document organization, audit evidence and local model decisions for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Graph, document audit and Codex decision workspace
interface.longDescription: Codex Atlas is a local repository workspace: inspect a bounded graph, organize decisions and plans, audit extraction and verification evidence, choose an advisor model, and prepare a cited Codex handoff. Optional OpenAI Responses calls use a local environment key, strict structured output, bounded snippets, and no browser credentials.
